results: Recurring revenue accounted for 91.6% (87.1%) of total revenue. · Operating Result: SEK 15.4 million (SEK 5.6 million), an increase of 175%, driven by the 19% recovery in series production and lower operating expenses.

Recurring revenue accounted for 93.6% (92.9%) of the revenue. · Operating Result: SEK 29.1 million (SEK 27.0 million), an increase of 8%, supported by higher recurring revenue and lower operating expenses, despite prior-year net operating exchange gains of SEK 3.5 million.

Recurring revenue increased by 53% year-on-year to SEK 31.4 million, representing more than 91% of total revenue and marking the fourth consecutive quarter of recurring revenue growth.

results: As investment in public charging slowed sharply, our order intake decreased by 19% and revenue by 10%.
Against this backdrop, our revenue grew 12% in January-September.
In Q3, while new public DC fast charging installations in Europe declined 22%, our European revenue declined 5%, and in Europe outside the Nordics it grew 10%.
In the Nordics, revenue decreased 30% as existing customers moderated investments.
Our revenue there declined 37% in Q3, but is up 32% from the beginning of the year.

outlook.text: The new outlook is as follows: 2026 revenue is expected to grow approximately 5% compared to year 2025, assuming no major impact from foreign currency exchange rates (revenue 2025: EUR 251.3 million). 2026 operative EBIT is expected to be lower compared to year 2025 (operative EBIT 2025: EUR -12.4 million).

Previous outlook: 2026 revenue is expected to grow between 10%–25% compared to year 2025, assuming no major impact from foreign currency exchange rates (revenue 2025: EUR 251.3 million). 2026 operative EBIT is expected to improve significantly compared to year 2025 (operative EBIT 2025: EUR -12.4 million).
The updated financial targets are: Revenue growth: 15-25% CAGR over 2025–2030, in constant currency, range based on different market growth scenarios.
With an order backlog of EUR 128 million (9% higher than a year ago) and liquidity of EUR 91 million, we have the backlog and balance sheet to deliver.
